market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.2m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Per OPEC secondary sources, Venezuela was ~1.0-1.1m bpd in Q1 2026 with stabilization around 1.1m bpd. Reaching 1.2m bpd requires ~10% upside from current run rate. With Chevron joint ventures expanding and recovery trend, plausible but not the base case given Goldman 900k flat forecast and capacity constraints.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace of Chevron-led recovery and OPEC secondary source methodology
